properties.name: Reasoning is evaluated once per report, and a reading under a circle is kept with the stack state it depends on
properties.rationale: The root cause of the 2026-10-25 Shop stall (fact:root-cause-the-shop-stall-...-2026-10-25, C1). Which limit dominated depends on the design, measured each alone: on the Shop's own export (no circles on main, 0 cuts) the per-call memo was the whole cost and sharing alone took reasoning_report 2.6 s to 0.52 s; on a Shop-shaped design whose constraints object to each other in pairs, the unkept readings under a cut circle dominated (sharing alone: 6.3 s at 34 steps, 16 s at 44, unchanged growth; keeping cut readings alone: 1.7 s and 2.7 s; both: 0.27 s and 0.36 s). Caching type_holding (a read per schema type) then halved what was left. A circle is read exactly as before, so a reading under one depends on which nodes are on the evaluation's stack; keeping it per stack state is what makes the memo exact rather than an approximation of each circle as one verdict. A reading that met the depth limit is never shared. Found on the way and left alone: detect_defects lists a mutual contradiction's two edges in store iteration order, which varies run to run (the golden sorts it); and a debug build overflows a 2 MiB thread stack on a 56-step chain, on main as after (the tests run on a 64 MiB thread). Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Built dec:reasoning-evaluation-is-memoized-across-cycles-and-shared-across-a-report on branch fix/reasoning-memo-shared. One memo is shared across every evaluation a report, loop_status, detect_gaps, a what-if or another whole-design reader runs (crates/reflow2-core/src/inference/memo.rs); a reading computed under a cut circle is kept with the stack entries it was cut on and those it found off the stack, and handed back only when the stack agrees; type_holding and reasoning_debt are worked out once per scope. reasoning_report's small-budget fallback now shortens the summary lists (bound_reply_sampling) and counts its own labels before it says a reply fits. Timings, release, 8-core desktop: Shop export reasoning_report 2.6 s to 0.25 s, loop_status 4.5 s to 0.30 s, detect_gaps 2.9 s to 0.22 s; 56-step Shop-shaped design with objection circles from minutes to 0.24 / 0.23 / 0.21 s. Every reading of 17 fixtures and two Shop-shaped designs equals a golden taken on main 367cd86d8.
